statutory Determination No. 4649 Unique No. : r/210
Statutory Determination under Section 19 of the Land reform
law, no. 1 of 1972

whereas a statutory declaration under Section 18 of the Law has been made by Mrs. Agampodi Misinona of No. 133, Kariyamaditta, the Land Reform Commission by virtue of the powers vested in it under Section 19 of the Law, has made a statutory determination for her estate (nominally) as she is now deceased, specifying the portion of agricultural land owned by the statutory lessee which she shall be allowed to retain. The agricultural land so allowed to be retained by statutory lessee is described in the Schedule below.
Ranawakachchi Kankanamge Nihal, Chairman, Land Reform Commission.
No. 475,Kaduwela Road,Battaramulla,On 17th March, 2025.
